nodes.name: agent_manager.py
nodes.summary: Agent lifecycle management: main/sub agent startup, parallel sub-agent scheduling, LLM client caching, skill execution with context injection

nodes.name: skill_executor.py
nodes.summary: Pipeline execution engine: orchestrates 10-step report generation pipeline, supports Tab (parallel) and Pipeline (serial) modes, LLM multi-candidate auto-failover routing, streaming chat
nodes.languageNotes: Python核心模块 — 1388行，系统最复杂的编排引擎

nodes.name: builtin_tools.py
nodes.summary: Built-in tool factories: file read/write with path whitelist, batch PDF-to-MD conversion (PyMuPDF/PyPDF2 fallback), RAG knowledge base query, memory persistence, todo list management

nodes.name: tool_registry.py
nodes.summary: Tool registry: defines ToolDef dataclass, ToolRegistry with register/search/list, JSON schema to Pydantic conversion, and ToolSearch/SkillSearch meta-tool factories for Agent self-discovery

nodes.name: execute_tool.py
nodes.summary: Unified tool executor with flyweight pattern: permission whitelist check, execution logging, sync/async dual-path execution, todo nag injection, LangChain StructuredTool adapter

nodes.name: deep_agent.py
nodes.summary: LangGraph ReAct Agent factory: creates autonomous (standard ReAct) or sequential (step-chain) agents, manages LLM client creation with SSL/HTTP config, parallel/serial tool call control, LLM client sharing

nodes.name: llm_callback.py
nodes.summary: LLM call tracing: global LLMCallTracker singleton with in-memory ring buffer for recent call history, and LangChain BaseCallbackHandler for automatic ChatOpenAI invocation recording with key sanitization

nodes.name: config_manager.py
nodes.summary: YAML hierarchical configuration: loads platform.yaml and agent configs from directory structure, supports env var override for API keys, dot-notation access, validation, and watchdog file-change reloading

nodes.name: AgentManager
nodes.summary: Manages the complete lifecycle of LangGraph ReAct Agents: creates main agent and sub-agents from config, dynamically spawns skill-specific agents, schedules parallel sub-agent execution with Semaphore concurrency control, caches LLM clients for reuse, injects patient data context with adaptive truncation

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Initializes AgentManager with config, registry, memory, logger, context/todo managers; sets up parallel tool call flag and LLM client cache dict

nodes.name: _get_or_create_llm
nodes.summary: Returns cached ChatOpenAI instance keyed by (model, base_url, api_key, proxy_flag); creates new one if not found, with temperature from config and custom HTTP client

nodes.name: start_main_agent
nodes.summary: Creates and stores the main LangGraph ReAct Agent using 'main' agent config

nodes.name: discover_sub_agents
nodes.summary: Discovers and creates all configured sub-agents (except 'main'), returning list of created names

nodes.name: spawn_agent
nodes.summary: Dynamically creates a temporary agent with given name, system prompt, and optional model override; raises if name already exists

nodes.name: run_skill
nodes.summary: Executes a Skill by creating a temporary ReAct Agent with assembled tools, injecting patient files/knowledge/prior reports into user message (not system prompt) to avoid per-round context bloat, manages memory offloading and context compression, 600s timeout for complex steps

nodes.name: spawn_sub_agent
nodes.summary: Creates a temporary sub-agent to execute a skill, auto-destroys after completion

nodes.name: spawn_sub_agent_isolated
nodes.summary: Creates an isolated sub-agent with independent context injected as JSON in system prompt; applies complexity-based recursion limits; 120s timeout; auto-destroys after execution

nodes.name: schedule_sub_agents
nodes.summary: Serial scheduling: executes multiple sub-agent tasks one by one, returning ordered results

nodes.name: spawn_sub_agents_parallel
nodes.summary: Parallel sub-agent execution: uses asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent=4) for concurrency control, each sub-agent isolated via spawn_sub_agent_isolated, individual failures caught as Exception objects without affecting others

nodes.name: destroy_agent
nodes.summary: Removes a named agent from the registry; prevents destruction of 'main' agent

nodes.name: list_agents
nodes.summary: Returns all registered agent names

nodes.name: get_agent_status
nodes.summary: Returns status dict for a named agent or None

nodes.name: get_agent
nodes.summary: Returns the callable agent instance by name

nodes.name: route_message
nodes.summary: Routes a message to a target agent asynchronously via ainvoke

nodes.name: _assemble_tools
nodes.summary: Assembles agent toolset: ToolSearch + SkillSearch meta-tools + ExecuteTool, filtered by agent's available_tools config

nodes.name: _assemble_tools_for_skill
nodes.summary: Assembles skill execution toolset: base tools plus sessions_spawn and sessions_spawn_parallel for sub-agent creation

nodes.name: _run_knowledge_retrieval_direct
nodes.summary: Direct RAG execution bypassing LLM: extracts query from context dict with recursive key search, invokes rag_query tool handler directly with top_k control

nodes.name: _create_sessions_spawn_tool
nodes.summary: Creates sessions_spawn ToolDef: agent-callable tool that resolves sub-skill path, parses SKILL.md, spawns isolated sub-agent, returns sub-agent output; special-cases knowledge-retrieval for direct RAG

nodes.name: _create_sessions_spawn_parallel_tool
nodes.summary: Creates sessions_spawn_parallel ToolDef: agent-callable tool that spawns multiple isolated sub-agents concurrently via asyncio.gather, returns all outputs assembled

nodes.name: _build_file_index
nodes.summary: Generates lightweight file index (name+size only) from JSON patient files, used by non-clinical steps to avoid 80KB context injection

nodes.name: _truncate_files_text
nodes.summary: Truncates patient data to 15KB max with per-file 300-char limit; handles both JSON array and Markdown formats, avoids multi-byte UTF-8 cut

nodes.name: _truncate_prior_reports
nodes.summary: Truncates prior reports text to 30KB max with truncation note

nodes.name: resolve_sub_skill_path
nodes.summary: Resolves a sub-skill reference path: tries relative to parent skill dir, then falls back to global skills base dir; raises FileNotFoundError if unresolved

nodes.name: _get_sub_agent_recursion_limit
nodes.summary: Returns recursion limit based on skill complexity: 15 for simple prefixes, 35 for full skills

nodes.name: PipelineStep
nodes.summary: Dataclass representing a single pipeline step with name, display_name, skill_file, keywords for KB relevance scoring, and has_schema flag

nodes.name: SkillExecutor
nodes.summary: Core orchestration engine: bridges Web layer and Agent layer; supports Tab mode (parallel multi-skill) and Pipeline mode (serial 10-step report generation); manages LLM multi-candidate auto-failover with transient error retry; handles streaming chat, report assembly, JSON/Markdown output normalization, KB query with step-specific relevance scoring

nodes.name: __init__
nodes.summary: Initializes SkillExecutor with agent_manager, knowledge_base, llm_candidates list, disabled_providers set, and pipeline steps

nodes.name: load_skills
nodes.summary: Parses all SKILL.md files from a directory and registers them

nodes.name: load_pipeline
nodes.summary: Loads pipeline step configuration from YAML

nodes.name: _format_knowledge
nodes.summary: Formats KB query results into ranked text with evidence level, edition, and source info

nodes.name: _apply_llm_candidate
nodes.summary: Applies LLM candidate config (api_key, base_url, model) to the platform config dynamically

nodes.name: _candidate_names
nodes.summary: Returns comma-separated names of all LLM candidates for error messaging

nodes.name: _is_step_specific_error
nodes.summary: Classifies whether an error is step-specific (Agent recursion, context limit) vs infrastructure-wide (auth, timeout, rate-limit, network); only infrastructure errors cascade-disable subsequent steps

nodes.name: _classify_llm_error
nodes.summary: Classifies LLM errors into 7 categories: auth failure, timeout, recursion limit, context exceeded, rate limit, server error, network failure; returns user-facing Chinese labels

nodes.name: _extract_system_prompt
nodes.summary: Extracts ## System Prompt code block from SKILL.md body via regex

nodes.name: _extract_json
nodes.summary: Extracts JSON from model output: removes code fences, finds outermost {} braces, auto-fixes trailing commas, balances braces

nodes.name: _is_invalid_agent_output
nodes.summary: Detects LangGraph recursion-limit fallback messages (short, generic 'need more steps' patterns)

nodes.name: _json_to_markdown
nodes.summary: Converts JSON dict to readable Markdown, skipping internal fields and metadata

nodes.name: _clean_agent_content
nodes.summary: Strips agent monologue/planning text from report content: removes '### result' lines, code fence markers, structured-output headings, and agent internal monologue blocks

nodes.name: _extract_structured_from_markdown
nodes.summary: When LLM outputs Markdown instead of JSON, extracts structured fields by matching ## headings against a step-specific heading-to-field mapping; returns None if no match

nodes.name: reset_disabled_providers
nodes.summary: Clears the set of disabled LLM providers for a fresh run

nodes.name: llm_status
nodes.summary: Returns LLM status including candidates list, disabled providers, timeouts, proxy env info

nodes.name: _run_skill_with_llm_candidates
nodes.summary: Core LLM routing: iterates through candidates, applies provider config, retries transient errors once (rate-limit/timeout/server-error/network), skips disabled providers, raises classified RuntimeError on exhaustion

nodes.name: _run_skill_via_agent
nodes.summary: Delegates skill execution to AgentManager.run_skill with step-specific recursion limits, validates output (rejects recursion-limit fallback messages), wraps result as JSON, tracks via LLMCallTracker

nodes.name: execute_chat
nodes.summary: Main chat SSE stream: yields 'thinking' status, streams reasoning/token events via LLM multi-candidate failover, falls back to local file summary if all candidates fail

nodes.name: _chunked
nodes.summary: Splits text into fixed-size chunks for streaming

nodes.name: _build_chat_prompt
nodes.summary: Constructs chat message list: system prompt + recent history (last 8) + patient data block + user question

nodes.name: _build_chat_fallback
nodes.summary: Builds offline-mode fallback text with patient file summary when no LLM available

nodes.name: _stream_main_llm
nodes.summary: OpenAI SDK streaming: creates AsyncOpenAI client, streams chat completions with reasoning_content support, tracks via LLMCallTracker, enforces idle timeout

nodes.name: execute_report_skills
nodes.summary: Full report pipeline: determines fast/full mode (skips 01-04 if OCR ready), queries KB with step-specific relevance scoring, executes steps serially with step-aware file budgets, generates tab_ready/token SSE events, writes pipeline timing logs and report JSON to disk, archives generated report context

nodes.name: _write_generated_report_context
nodes.summary: Persists the current report as prior context for longitudinal comparison: generates Markdown and JSON formats via report_context module

nodes.name: _background_clean_cache
nodes.summary: Background task: cleans KB results using TextCleaner, updates in-memory cache

nodes.name: load_pipeline_config
nodes.summary: Loads and parses pipeline YAML configuration, returns list of PipelineStep dataclass instances

nodes.name: _load_step_schema
nodes.summary: Loads optional Function Calling schema.json for a pipeline step

nodes.name: _score_result_for_step
nodes.summary: Scores a KB result by keyword frequency count for step-specific relevance sorting

nodes.name: _build_previous_summary
nodes.summary: Builds dependency-aware previous results summary: only extracts predecessor steps' relevant fields, truncates per-field to 400 chars, total under 3000, fallback to last-3-steps with content_preview if over limit

nodes.name: _file_category_summary
nodes.summary: Auto-categorizes patient files by directory path, returns human-readable count summary

nodes.name: _first_content_snippet
nodes.summary: Returns first non-empty file content snippet for preview

nodes.name: _format_files_for_prompt
nodes.summary: Renders patient file list as Markdown with per-file and total character budgets; optionally adds OCR-complete header to prevent redundant PDF conversion by Agent

nodes.name: _has_loaded_ocr_content
nodes.summary: Checks if any file has pre-loaded OCR Markdown content (route-level optimization)

nodes.name: _resolve_and_check
nodes.summary: Path resolution with whitelist enforcement: resolves relative path against project root, checks against allowed prefix list, raises ValueError on violation

nodes.name: create_read_file_tool
nodes.summary: Creates read_file ToolDef with 10MB limit, whitelisted to Data/TempData/Result/ paths

nodes.name: create_batch_pdf_conversion_tool
nodes.summary: Creates batch_pdf_to_md ToolDef: uses PyMuPDF (fitz) for text extraction, falls back to PyPDF2; outputs .md files and conversion_report.json

nodes.name: _convert_via_pypdf2
nodes.summary: PyPDF2 fallback PDF-to-MD conversion when PyMuPDF is unavailable

nodes.name: create_write_file_tool
nodes.summary: Creates write_file ToolDef with 10MB limit, whitelisted only to Result/ directory

nodes.name: create_save_memory_tool
nodes.summary: Creates save_memory ToolDef for LLM to persist information to long-term memory (append/overwrite)

nodes.name: create_read_memory_tool
nodes.summary: Creates read_memory ToolDef for LLM to retrieve stored long-term memory

nodes.name: create_rag_query_tool
nodes.summary: Creates rag_query ToolDef: intercepts Skill-level RAG calls, delegates to KnowledgeBase.query() for semantic retrieval, returns JSON results

nodes.name: create_todo_tool
nodes.summary: Creates todo ToolDef: manages multi-step task progress via todo_manager, logs updates

nodes.name: ToolDef
nodes.summary: Dataclass defining a tool: name, description, JSON parameters schema, source (builtin/platform/skill/mcp), and optional async/sync handler with to_langchain_tool() adapter

nodes.name: ToolRegistry
nodes.summary: Central tool registry: register/unregister/get/list_all/search tools by name/description with case-insensitive matching

nodes.name: _json_type_to_python
nodes.summary: Maps JSON schema types (string/integer/number/boolean/array/object) to Python types

nodes.name: _json_schema_to_pydantic
nodes.summary: Converts JSON schema to a Pydantic model using create_model() for LangChain StructuredTool validation

nodes.name: create_tool_search_tool
nodes.summary: Creates ToolSearch meta-tool: enables Agent to discover available tools by keyword search or list all

nodes.name: create_skill_search_tool
nodes.summary: Creates SkillSearch meta-tool: enables Agent to discover registered skills (source=skill) by keyword or list all

nodes.name: to_langchain_tool
nodes.summary: Converts ToolDef to LangChain StructuredTool with Pydantic args schema; preserves async handler for LangGraph compatibility

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a tool by name, warns on overwrite

nodes.name: unregister
nodes.summary: Removes a tool by name from registry

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Looks up a ToolDef by name, returns None if not found

nodes.name: list_all
nodes.summary: Returns all registered ToolDef instances as a list

nodes.name: search
nodes.summary: Case-insensitive search across tool name and description

nodes.name: ExecuteTool
nodes.summary: Unified tool execution flyweight: validates tool name against permission whitelist, looks up in registry, logs call/result, executes handler with sync/async dual-path, injects todo nag reminders

nodes.name: _execute
nodes.summary: Shared execution pipeline: permission check -> registry lookup -> call log -> execute handler -> result log -> todo nag injection; handles both sync and async handlers

nodes.name: run_async
nodes.summary: Async execution entry point, delegates to _execute

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Sync execution with dual-mode: uses run_coroutine_threadsafe if in running event loop, otherwise asyncio.run()

nodes.name: as_tool
nodes.summary: Returns self as a ToolDef with async handler wrapping run_async, exposing ExecuteTool as a LangChain-compatible tool

nodes.name: build_ssl_context
nodes.summary: Builds SSL context with lowered SECLEVEL for OpenSSL 3.0 TLS handshake compatibility, TLS 1.2 minimum

nodes.name: llm_trust_env_proxy
nodes.summary: Checks MEDAGENT_LLM_TRUST_ENV_PROXY env var to determine if LLM HTTP client should honor system proxy

nodes.name: llm_timeout_seconds
nodes.summary: Reads MEDAGENT_LLM_HTTP_TIMEOUT env var for LLM HTTP timeout, defaults to 120s, minimum 10s

nodes.name: make_sync_llm_http_client
nodes.summary: Creates httpx.Client with configured timeout and proxy trust

nodes.name: make_async_llm_http_client
nodes.summary: Creates httpx.AsyncClient with configured timeout and proxy trust

nodes.name: create_deep_agent
nodes.summary: Factory for LangGraph ReAct agents: creates ChatOpenAI LLM (or accepts shared instance), configures parallel/serial tool calls via bind_tools wrapper pattern, selects autonomous (create_react_agent) or sequential (_SequentialAgent) mode

nodes.name: build_tools_from_registry
nodes.summary: Builds a list of LangChain tools from ToolRegistry, optionally filtered by allowed_tools list

nodes.name: _SequentialAgent
nodes.summary: Sequential step-chain agent: splits system prompt by numbered steps, executes each as separate LLM call with accumulated context, supports invoke/ainvoke/astream_events

nodes.name: invoke
nodes.summary: Synchronous step-chain execution: splits steps, iterates with accumulated context, returns all messages

nodes.name: ainvoke
nodes.summary: Asynchronous step-chain execution

nodes.name: astream_events
nodes.summary: Simplified streaming for sequential mode: yields final AI message as streaming event

nodes.name: _split_steps
nodes.summary: Splits text by numbered steps (1. xxx 2. xxx ...), returns list of step bodies without numbering

nodes.name: _sanitize
nodes.summary: Redacts API keys matching sk- pattern from text for safe logging

nodes.name: _short
nodes.summary: Truncates text to limit chars with overflow count, sanitizes API keys

nodes.name: _key_tail
nodes.summary: Returns masked API key showing only last 4 characters

nodes.name: LLMCallTracker
nodes.summary: Global singleton LLM call tracker: records all LLM invocations (start/succeed/fail) in a thread-safe ring buffer with key sanitization, used for /api/debug/llm endpoint

nodes.name: instance
nodes.summary: Returns the singleton LLMCallTracker instance, creates if needed

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Records the start of an LLM call: agent, model, base_url, key tail, prompt stats, returns call_id

nodes.name: succeed
nodes.summary: Marks an LLM call as successful with response stats and latency

nodes.name: fail
nodes.summary: Marks an LLM call as failed with error type and sanitized message

nodes.name: recent
nodes.summary: Returns most recent N records in reverse chronological order

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Clears all records and inflight calls

nodes.name: LLMCallbackHandler
nodes.summary: LangChain BaseCallbackHandler: automatically records ChatOpenAI invocations (chat_model_start/llm_start/llm_end/llm_error) by mapping LangGraph run_ids to LLMCallTracker call_ids

nodes.name: on_chat_model_start
nodes.summary: LangChain callback: triggers on chat model start, extracts prompt from messages, starts tracking

nodes.name: on_llm_start
nodes.summary: LangChain callback: triggers on completion model start

nodes.name: on_llm_end
nodes.summary: LangChain callback: extracts generation text, marks call as successful

nodes.name: on_llm_error
nodes.summary: LangChain callback: marks call as failed with error details

nodes.name: AgentConfig
nodes.summary: Dataclass for agent configuration: name, system_prompt, available_tools/skills lists, optional model override

nodes.name: ConfigManager
nodes.summary: Hierarchical YAML config manager: loads platform.yaml and per-agent configs from directory structure (system_prompt.txt, available_tools.txt, LLM_model.txt), supports env var overrides for API keys, dot-notation key access, validation, and watchdog-based file-change auto-reload

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Loads platform config then agent configs

nodes.name: _load_platform
nodes.summary: Loads platform.yaml, applies environment variable override for LLM_API_KEY

nodes.name: _load_agents
nodes.summary: Loads main agent from agents/main/ directory, then discovers sub-agents via atomic reference swap

nodes.name: _load_sub_agents_into
nodes.summary: Discovers sub-agents from agents/sub/ directory, inheriting parent configs

nodes.name: _load_agent_dir
nodes.summary: Loads a single agent config from directory: reads system_prompt.txt, available_tools/skills.txt, LLM_model.txt, inherits from parent if specified

nodes.name: _load_list_file
nodes.summary: Reads a text file line by line, returns non-empty stripped lines as list

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Dot-notation config access: 'llm.base_url' -> navigates nested platform dict, returns default on miss

nodes.name: get_agent_config
nodes.summary: Returns AgentConfig by name, or None

nodes.name: list_agents
nodes.summary: Returns all registered agent names

nodes.name: validate
nodes.summary: Validates required config fields: llm.base_url, llm.api_key, llm.default_model, main agent config

nodes.name: watch
nodes.summary: Starts watchdog file-system observer on agents_dir and platform.yaml parent; debounces 500ms before calling reload callback

nodes.name: stop_watch
nodes.summary: Stops watchdog observer with 2s join timeout
